title: Feature catalog + plan conformance check (engine stability): register every feature, show per plan/run what is on/off/missing and why, static check for unregistered features
requirement: Every engine feature SHALL be registered once in a feature catalog; a conformance check per plan and per run shows on/off/missing with the reason; a static check fails on an unregistered step or setting. Design first from a gap analysis; no over-engineering. REQ-0091 (RAW-00721, RAW-00722); REQ-0090 logreach is the first consumer
acceptance_criteria: coverage gaps=0, old reports byte-identical, 0 claude calls

design.summary: features.conf catalog + feature_state (features_common.sh) + logreach profile from product + plan.sh features view + static catalog test + run features.json/report line + run preflight drift guard; all $0, no prompt change

implementation.summary: 123.1-123.7: features.conf + features_common.sh (feature_state/feature_on/preflight), logreach profile from product, plan.sh features view, pipeline status line, features_catalog_test drift guard, <run>/features.json + exec report line, run preflight (missing/new/changed)

unit_test.result: 176 suites, 172 pass; 4 fail = ext_scan, track_hook, tracking_new_only (pre-existing, TASK-078) + ext_pregate T8 load flake (passes alone 28/0, re-run by main); shell.sh 537/0; bite: catalog test FAILs on drift; evidence work/TASK-123/evidence/{full_run_all,shell_checks,bite_catalog}.txt

security.result: no claude/paid calls added; logreach profile files checked for existence only; no link values or secrets in new outputs (verifier); no REPOS_ROOT reads; prompts unchanged

verification.command: verifier V1-V8 + main extras (inputs_sha, products_check, bites, full run at e852186)
verification.result: V1-V8 PASS, REQ-0091 AC1-6 + REQ-0090 AC1-2 PASS; full run_all 173/176 (3 known TASK-078); shell 537/0; qlv5 re-render: only timestamp diffs, QA PASS, coverage gaps=0; inputs_sha equal with/without features.json; 123.8 bite fails on old code
